# IfafWebStudio

> IfafWebStudio is a founder-led website development and digital business support studio based in Manipal (Udupi district), Karnataka, India, run by Mohammed Ifaf. It builds business, WordPress, hotel/resort/homestay, restaurant and taxi/travel websites, and provides local SEO, Google Business Profile optimization, GEO/AEO, AI chatbots, WhatsApp automation and content support for businesses in Manipal, Udupi and across India.

Key facts:

- Name: IfafWebStudio (also written "Ifaf Web Studio")
- Founder: Mohammed Ifaf — AI Website Developer & Digital Business Support
- Location: Manipal, Udupi district, Karnataka 576104, India
- Serves: Manipal, Udupi, Karnataka and clients across India (work is coordinated over WhatsApp, phone and email)
- Focus: hospitality (hotels, resorts, homestays, guest houses), travel and taxi, restaurants and local-service businesses
- Phone / WhatsApp: +91 96860 44715
- Email: mohammedifaf522@gmail.com
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/ifafwebstudio/
- Budget ranges listed on the enquiry form start from ₹20,000–₹30,000; final cost depends on scope
- The website does not publish invented testimonials, awards, client counts, rankings or performance statistics

## Service pages

- [Business & WordPress website development](https://ifafwebstudio.com/services/wordpress-website-development/): WordPress, custom-coded and responsive websites, redesigns
- [Hotel, resort & homestay websites](https://ifafwebstudio.com/services/hotel-resort-website-development/): Rooms, galleries, location and direct WhatsApp booking enquiries
- [Restaurant websites & QR digital menus](https://ifafwebstudio.com/services/restaurant-website-qr-menu/): Mobile menus, QR menus, timings, location and Google Business Profile
- [Taxi & travel websites](https://ifafwebstudio.com/services/taxi-travel-website-development/): Fleet, routes, service areas and one-tap booking
- [AI chatbots & WhatsApp automation](https://ifafwebstudio.com/services/ai-chatbot-whatsapp-automation/): AI chatbots, WhatsApp automation, AI business assistants, workflow automation
- [Local SEO, Google Business Profile, GEO & AEO](https://ifafwebstudio.com/services/local-seo-google-business-profile/): Technical SEO, local SEO, GBP optimization, generative and answer engine optimization
- [Website developer in Udupi](https://ifafwebstudio.com/website-developer-udupi/): Web development for Udupi businesses from nearby Manipal
